Scope: corpus-intake, pipeline, codec, examples, docs/data/sherlock

Acceptance criteria:
1. Admit a versioned subject/session/task/run manifest binding dataset revision and actual transcript, events, sidecar and image-header identities. Canonical participant IDs and aliases are explicit; each run retains its own axis. Distinguish source-media, composition, transcript, raw acquisition and selected analysis-volume clocks.
2. Independently establish full-part media onset, multipart boundaries, actual sample count/TR, recall padding and subject/run-specific crop/drop rules from primary records and media/header checks. Full-part playback-to-scan joins retain introductory material. Cartoon/episode transition timing is a separate checked capability required for an episode-only selection; unresolved transitions do not block an otherwise verified full-part join. Preserve contradictions as unresolved capabilities; never substitute a universal cartoon subtraction, a Princeton offset or notebook-repair duration for measured raw-BIDS joins.
3. Reuse exact coordinate/ClockRepair contracts where applicable. Retain gaps, uncovered tails, discontinuities, scan-break metadata and occurrence identity; declare any unestablished transform unavailable. The existing closed production ClockRepair ticket certifies annotation intake only, not scanner timing.
4. Export sample windows/indices and sparse semantic weights with mapping/projection/crosswalk digests, mask/missingness and all excluded/unprojectable mass. Zero-based volume indexing and volume-sampling convention are explicit. HRF/lag transforms are separate named operators with edge handling; signed regressors are never called probabilities. Neuroimaging preprocessing/model fitting stays outside StoryModel.
5. An independent reader recovers authored timing landmarks in a synthetic multipart case and one admitted development participant before cohort expansion; include alias shift, wrong run/origin, off-by-one volume, crop-versus-cartoon, missing events and duration-disagreement falsifiers. Account for every requested participant/run as success or typed failure.
6. Document a reproducible CLI-to-Python/R imaging walkthrough, uncertainty-versus-point/top-k comparison and lost-mass/timing-sensitivity outputs. Alignment fitting cannot use the neural outcome being evaluated. Preserve existing participant access, privacy and frozen evaluation rules.

Boundary: OpenNeuro raw/BIDS is the selected first adapter; generic temporal contracts remain corpus-independent. Does not reopen historical parity or claim the full G2 organization preview, fMRI efficacy or calibration.

Implementation evidence: exact baseline/result revisions, bound commands/test totals/exit, artifact digests, independent known answers, one failing mutation with an accepting control per guarantee, compatibility impact and separate cold review. StoryModel uses tools/reference-scope.sh and clean exact-revision sbt -batch checkAll. Proposed suites are acceptance specifications until implemented. No held-out corpus read, hosted spend, recruitment, publication or calibration is authorized by this engineering ticket.

tasks.title: G3: optional evidence-backed within-event localization with fail-coarse outputs
acceptance: Refine plausible source events using admitted time-anchored annotation/dialogue/ASR/visual evidence and the existing provider-feature contracts. Retain coarse event mass and its residual when no finer evidence exists; unsupported refinements return a broad or unavailable localization.

Separate localization of a particular occurrence from event extent and genuine multi-event summaries. Return alternative disjoint regions and occurrence IDs. Candidate coverage, truncation and residual coarse mass remain inspectable.

A finer candidate partition with unchanged information/prior cannot create confidence. Declare prior/base measure and evidence selection; do not turn repeated frames or duplicated captions into independent evidence. Source/recall and retrieval information use are receipted.

Synthetic exact-evidence, contradictory-evidence, repeated-occurrence and no-fine-evidence controls demonstrate fail-coarse behavior, mass conservation and no invented precision. Bind new kernels to mapping/evidence/projection identities and expose them through the existing CLI/exchange/Atlas contract.

Ship the engineering result as explicitly uncalibrated. Existing reliability ticket bd-01M2TAEW794XCR7D2HZJFNXVJY owns separate continuous-event validation and calibration; the legacy within-scene human packet is diagnostic only. Broad summaries are valid outputs and are not forced to a point gold label.
